change: ARM32 and Thumb regions cross pages only at observed entries; page-straddling Thumb instructions stay interpreted
method: 3 alternating before/after fresh-process runs, serial. 50 calls each: 25 warmup and 25 retained samples; 1,000,000 loop iterations (4,000,001 guest instructions) per call. Every call checks result 3,000,000 and loop counter 0. Same-page control uses identical relative code layout. Compilation excluded from retained samples.
scope: Synthetic native region-transition benchmark, not application latency or an Android overhead comparison.

doodleJump.method: Three alternating fresh-browser full e2e flows per side, serial, stable source, no profiling. 1080x2160@480; headless Chrome with SwiftShader, the default e2e settings. ReleaseFast; baseline platform AOT 3c267c36c60899fc. Each run rendered all six steps. No reference scoring exists for this flow. FPS is the harness presentation rate, not tap latency. Back has a variable idle wait and is excluded from startup/steady summaries.
